rv.q: This production catches the Sybaritic jollity, the vivid vim of the Dream.
Grandage's production is sexy, swift and sure-footed, a constant delight to the eye and never lets us forget that this is a play about the magical capacity for change.
Scampering and winking, this amiable production will also be remembered as an evening of spliffs and knickers.
But it is hard to warm to A Midsummer Night’s Dream with a Bottom who gives you the willies.

cn.t: Critics are divided on Grandage's star-driven Dream: Walliams' campy Bottom delights some but frustrates others, while Sheridan Smith earns warmer praise. A visually charming production that sacrifices depth for celebrity appeal.
